node.title: Re^8: crypto with core modules only

node.doctext:
Ummm ... it looks to me that this is in response to the post that I made.

I meant I was poking a hole in the first sentence of [id://1221430|this] post - are we talking about the same thing here? :-)

On the contrary, I expected that my statement "You aren't the only one" would have indicated my agreement with your stance.

Yes, sorry, I apparently kind of skipped that and focused too much on the other two paragraphs - it seemed to me like you might be comparing my post to some of the vitriol that's happened here, which I disagreed with (Update: or rather, I was hoping I wasn't being that bad...).

And I'm still not going to engage in that other speculation ;-)
